lines.text: Many learners say: She is angry to me.
Better: She is angry with me.
With! He is angry with me.

native.tip: Kita bilang “marah kepada saya”. Di bahasa Inggris, marah pada seseorang pakai angry with, bukan to.
native.caption: Pernah bilang begini? “She is angry to me.” 😅 Untuk marah pada seseorang, pakai angry with: “She is angry with me.” Dengarkan Kak Ama, lalu ulangi! Latihan lagi di app Lexkite.
native.comment: Jawaban: “with”. Ucapkan dengan lantang: “She is angry with me.” lalu tulis satu kalimat dengan angry with. Latihan gratis lainnya di sini: {link}

en.tip: We say “marah kepada saya”. In English, use angry with for a person, not to.
en.caption: Ever say this? “She is angry to me.” 😅 For a person, use angry with: “She is angry with me.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
